name: Project
description: A project of the Tasks library app: its tasks, statuses and labels, and who may see it (admins, members and guests, each kept as a grant on the project by the app)

fields.name: Key
fields.description: A short prefix for its task numbers, such as WEB (WEB-42)

fields.name: Admins
fields.description: People who administer the project: its settings, statuses, labels and people

fields.name: Members
fields.description: People who read and write its tasks, comments and checklists

fields.name: Guests
fields.description: People who read the project, comment and move its tasks, and see no other project

fields.name: Default view
fields.description: The view the project opens in

fields.name: Tracker connection
fields.description: An outside tracker (Trello, Asana…) the project is kept in step with (part 30h)

fields.name: Archived
fields.description: Archived projects are hidden from lists
